req.title: /status/<code> accepts POST
req.statement: The system shall accept POST requests on /status/<code> and return the requested code.

doc.reasoning: The requirement states that POST /status/<code> must return the requested HTTP status code. I design tests covering: (1) a standard 2xx positive case (EP), (2) a 4xx client-error negative case (NEG), (3) boundary values at the edges of common status code ranges (BVA), (4) a 5xx server-error code (DT), and (5) an invalid/non-numeric code (NEG). Each test asserts the exact status code returned, catching off-by-one and comparison-operator mutations. The view_status_code handler in core.py accepts POST via the methods list ['GET','POST','PUT','DELETE','PATCH','TRACE'] and delegates to the status_code() helper in helpers.py.
